guides.whenItHelps: Searches miss files you know exist, or Spotlight seems stuck indexing after a migration or restore. Rebuilding the index can fix a corrupted one.
guides.whenItWontHelp: On a healthy Mac this rarely helps, and it frees no disk space. Reindexing is slow and uses CPU for a while. It won't find files in folders excluded in System Settings > Spotlight.

guides.whenItHelps: Apps or files show generic, outdated or blank icons even though the app itself is fine.
guides.whenItWontHelp: Rarely helps on a healthy Mac and frees no disk space. If the app bundle itself has no icon, restarting changes nothing. If icons are still wrong after this, restart your Mac — that rebuilds the icon cache safely.

guides.symptom: Websites not resolving after a VPN or DNS change
guides.whenItHelps: Sites fail to load or resolve to old addresses right after switching VPN, DNS servers or networks, while other devices work.
guides.whenItWontHelp: If your network is down, the DNS server is wrong, or the site is down, flushing the cache changes nothing. It frees no disk space.

guides.whenItHelps: Space-bar previews show an old version of a file or a generic thumbnail.
guides.whenItWontHelp: Rarely helps on a healthy Mac and frees no meaningful disk space. If a preview is blank because no previewer supports the file type, resetting the cache won't add one.

guides.whenItHelps: Finder windows freeze or the Dock is unresponsive or glitchy. Both relaunch automatically.
guides.whenItWontHelp: Won't fix problems caused by a full disk, a misbehaving app, or a network volume that is hanging. It frees no disk space. Finder windows will close and reopen.
